nodes.label: ADR 0171: Engine DJ's playlists kept in step both ways
nodes.rationale: Playlists in GLUE's folder of the main library are Engine DJ's; written into the database the library is read from; merged three ways against what they last agreed on; a song Engine DJ doesn't have is added to its collection; gone from one side is asked about. Only while Engine DJ is closed, with backups, and one transaction for safety.
